# STEP 1 — Master Directory Structure & Architecture

```
ws/                                  # workspace root (Vite project)
├── index.html                       # canvas mount + overlay roots; <script type="module"> → /<GameName>/index.js
├── package.json                     # pinned: three@0.160.1, vite@5.4.8 · scripts: dev/build/preview · "type":"module"
│
├── shared/                          # ── REUSABLE ENGINE LAYER (identical across the whole collection) ──
│   ├── core/
│   │   ├── Engine.js                # renderer / scene / camera / clock; RAF loop with timescale support; resize; dispose() teardown walking a disposable registry
│   │   ├── InputController.js       # unified Keyboard + Gamepad API polling → one normalized per-frame snapshot (axes, edge-triggered buttons, deadzone)
│   │   └── ObjectPool.js            # generic typed pool: prewarm / acquire / release / hard capacity — the single pooling primitive for bullets, enemies, particles, rings, trails, text
│   ├── math/
│   │   ├── MathUtils.js             # clamp, lerp, damp (framerate-independent), angle wrap, randRange, TAU
│   │   └── Noise.js                 # vanilla 2D simplex + fbm — drives geometry displacement & audio LFOs
│   ├── vfx/                         # the six required shared VFX systems
│   │   ├── CameraShake.js           # trauma-based: addTrauma(v) → decay, offset = trauma²·maxOffset, direction jitter; applied post-update to camera
│   │   ├── HitStop.js               # timescale dilation manager — freeze(duration, strength), priority so a heavier impact overrides a lighter one; eases back to 1.0
│   │   ├── ParticleManager.js       # CENTRALIZED hard cap: 500 live particles max; single InstancedMesh + pooled CPU structs; burst() presets (sparks / explosion / thruster); respects timescale
│   │   ├── ShockwaveRings.js        # pooled emissive RingGeometry meshes, radius expand + opacity fade on impacts/deaths
│   │   ├── MotionTrails.js          # pooled fading ribbon segments attached to fast movers; auto-culled below speed threshold
│   │   └── FloatingText.js          # pooled DOM score text projected from world space each frame (camera.project), depth-scaled, glassmorphism-styled
│   ├── audio/
│   │   ├── AudioEngine.js           # WebAudio master chain (gain → compressor); synthesized SFX primitives: laser, zap, explosion (filtered noise sweep), blip; unlocks on first gesture
│   │   └── MusicSequencer.js        # step-sequenced procedural chiptune loops; tempo/intensity hooks tied to gameplay state
│   ├── ui/
│   │   └── GlassUI.js               # glassmorphism design system: injected CSS (backdrop-filter blur, neon borders/glow), HUD panels (score/lives/wave) + start/pause/game-over screens with wired callbacks
│   ├── postfx/
│   │   └── ComposerSetup.js         # EffectComposer + RenderPass + UnrealBloomPass (tuned threshold/strength/radius so emissive glows without white-out) + OutputPass; per-game setBloom(); dispose()
│   └── procedural/
│       ├── TextureFactory.js        # Canvas-API textures: neon grid floor, emissive stripes, radial glow sprite, starfield — all THREE.CanvasTexture, correct colorSpace
│       └── GeometryFactory.js       # noise-displaced planes + cached shared geometries (rings, hulls) so games never rebuild what exists
│
└── <GameName>/                      # ── exactly one of the collection, in its own isolated folder ──
    ├── plan.md                      # STEP 2 deliverable for that specific game
    ├── index.js                     # entry: boots Engine, builds scene, wires systems, starts loop; full dispose on teardown
    ├── config.js                    # every tuning constant (speeds, caps, scoring, bloom values) in one place
    ├── entities/                    # PlayerShip.js / enemy types / Bullet.js — each with update(dt), pooled where hot-path
    └── systems/                     # CollisionSystem.js (hand-written circle/AABB/swept math — no physics lib), Spawner.js, Scoring.js
```

**Key architectural decisions baked into this layout:**

- **Import discipline:** games import only from `../shared/**`; shared never imports from a game folder. One-way dependency graph, zero deep-path ambiguity. Three.js addons resolve via the official `three/addons/...` export map (no Vite alias config needed).
- **Memory ownership rule:** every module that allocates GPU resources registers them with `Engine`'s disposable registry; teardown calls `.dispose()` on geometries, materials, and textures exactly once. Hot paths acquire/release from pools — never `new` in the update loop.
- **Timescale is global:** HitStop mutates one scalar consumed by `Engine`'s clock, so *every* system (particles, trails, audio sequencer) dilates consistently for free.

# Compliance Statements

**Anti-Lazy Directive — COMPLIANT.** Every function will be fully implemented and production-ready; placeholder comments (`// ... rest of logic`, etc.) are banned from all output. If a file exceeds the output budget I stop mid-file at an exact character boundary, and resume verbatim on `continue` with no preamble or restart.

**Strict Memory Management — COMPLIANT.** Object pooling for all projectiles/entities/particles via one shared `ObjectPool`; centralized 500-particle hard cap in `ParticleManager`; `InstancedMesh` for particles; explicit `.dispose()` on every geometry/material/texture through a single registry-driven teardown path.

**Sequential Output Protocol — COMPLIANT.** I will not generate the collection, and I have created no files or run no commands in this step. I await your trigger phrase: **`Begin [Game Name]`** for STEP 2 (the exhaustive `plan.md`).
